name: ChemoMetec A/S
summary: ChemoMetec A/S engages in the development, production, and sale of analytical equipment for cell counting and analysis the United States, Canada, Europe, and internationally. The company offers its solutions in the areas of cell and gene therapy, cancer and stem cell research, and development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals, as well as production and quality control of animal semen, milk, and beer. Its products include NucleoCounter NC-3000, an advanced image cytometer; NucleoCounter NC-250, an automated cell analyzer; NucleoCounter NC-202, a consistent cell counter; NucleoCounter NC-200, an automated cell counter that provides solution for cell counting and cell viability determination…
